say:2:1737119001:1.text: Legend has it that after his ascension, King Rolan's spirit came to dwell within the statue.
say:2:1737119001:1.source_cn: 传说自神圣升华之后，罗兰大帝的英灵，其实一直寄宿在这座...

say:3:1737119002:1.text: Day after day, he watched over the city, powerless to aid those plagued by cold, hunger, and sickness.
say:3:1737119002:1.source_cn: 他日夜俯瞰着这座城市，看着那些寒冷、饥饿、生病的人们，...

say:4:1737119003:1.text: One day, a lost little fox wandered to the foot of the statue and befriended King Rolan.
say:4:1737119003:1.source_cn: 直到有一天，一只迷路的小狐狸跑到了雕像脚下，成了罗兰大...

say:5:1737119004:1.text: To help those in need, King Rolan had the fox strip the gold leaf from his body and pry the gemstones from his sword hilt.
say:5:1737119004:1.source_cn: 对世人心生怜悯的罗兰大帝让小狐狸把他身上的金箔一片片剥...

say:6:1737119005:1.text: Oh... no wonder the statue is only partially covered by gold!
say:6:1737119005:1.source_cn: 哇……怪不得这座雕像没有全身都覆盖着金箔，原来是因为这个！

say:7:1737119006:1.text: Over time, the gold and gemstones on the statue dwindled...
say:7:1737119006:1.source_cn: 日子一天天过去，罗兰大帝身上的金子和宝石也就越来越少……

say:8:1737119007:1.text: If you ever find the statue looking less golden, it means King Rolan has given his gold to the poor again!
say:8:1737119007:1.source_cn: 所以啊，如果你哪天发现这些金箔也不见了，就说明是大帝又...

say:11:1737119008:0.source_cn: 咳咳！打扰一下二位的雅兴。

say:13:1737119009:0.text: No worries! Have you heard of this story, sir? Isn't it moving?
say:13:1737119009:0.source_cn: 哎呀！守备军大人？您也听过这个故事吗？是不是很感人？

say:14:1737119010:1.text: Moving? I won't comment on the part about the fox, but that explanation for the missing gold? It's made up by a thief!
say:14:1737119010:1.source_cn: 感人？哼，前面那段我也许管不着，但后面那段“后续”……...

say:15:1737119011:1.text: The thief goes around spreading the rumor, hoping no one will report it to the authorities when the gold goes missing!
say:15:1737119011:1.source_cn: 这家伙为了给自己的盗窃行为找借口，到处散播这种谣言，想...

say:16:1737119012:1.text: Just the other day, we caught him red-handed trying to pry the gold from the crown!
say:16:1737119012:1.source_cn: 就在前两天，他刚爬上雕像想撬王冠上的金子，就被我们当场...

say:18:1737119014:1.text: Yes. So, if you see anyone meddling with the statue, alert the guards at once! And don't buy into those stories about the king's "generosity"!
say:18:1737119014:1.source_cn: 没错。所以，二位以后要是再看到谁在雕像上动手动脚，别犹...
